default.notes: Apply for the USD 50 ordinary eVisa at visa.immigration.go.tz, or obtain the same visa on arrival (cash US dollars) at major airports and border posts.

groups.notes: East African Community citizens enter Tanzania without a visa under the EAC common market arrangements — stays of up to about 90 days are granted on arrival.

Nationals of most Commonwealth countries and southern African neighbours do not need a visa for visits of up to 90 days — the exemption list is maintained by the Immigration Department, so confirm on visa.immigration.go.tz before travel.

TZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Tanzanian citizens.

US.notes: US citizens are only eligible for the USD 100 multiple-entry visa (valid 12 months) — the USD 50 single-entry visa is not available to them; apply at visa.immigration.go.tz or on arrival.
